cards.name: Magnify & Preserve Alpha
cards.summary: Magnifying loupe that keeps the rest of the layer: a Magnify effect named '(Magnify)' (Circle, Magnification 200, Size 250, Link None, Blending Mode None, Center at the layer centre) is limited through its Compositing Options to the Add-mode mask 'Magnify Mask', whose path, feather and opacity expressions follow the lens. Outside that mask the layer stays untouched and visible, so no duplicate is needed underneath. The mask path is built with fromComp(Center + offset), i.e. it treats the effect's layer-space Center as comp coordinates: the mask only sits on the lens when the layer's pixels line up with the comp (100% scale, centred). On a scaled layer the mask drifts and shows a black/transparent hole instead of the loupe.
use_for: Zoom into a line of a newspaper, document or tweet screenshot in an explainer (precomposed at comp size)
Highlight a detail in a map or chart
Moving loupe that tracks across a text document (animate Magnify Center; the mask follows)
avoid: Magnifies pixels - low-res sources get soft/blocky at high magnification

Scaled or moved layers break it: on 1920x1080 footage fitted at 50% into a 960x540 comp the mask landed at the bottom-right corner as a black quarter-disc and no loupe showed - precompose the source at comp size first
cards.applies_to: any layer at 100% scale whose pixels line up with the comp (precompose scaled footage first)

cards.scripting: Set comp.time to the start time, deselect all layers, set layer.selected = true, then layer.applyPreset(new File(<preset .ffx path>)) (applyPreset can act on the current selection, so isolate the target first).
